hero.description: Haulage, workshops, construction, accounts — industries that still run on carbon paper and a filing cabinet. We're two engineers from Galway who put them on software. Hire us to build yours, or take one we've already built.

dockets.title: Bring us the problem.
dockets.body: You have a process held together by spreadsheets, WhatsApp and a lever-arch file. We sit with the people doing it, map what actually happens, then build the thing that replaces it — and hand it over working.

dockets.title: Or take one off the shelf.
dockets.body: Four platforms we built, run and sell ourselves. Fleet compliance, transport operations, project delivery and the books. Nothing to specify, nothing to wait for.

platforms.title: Four platforms, already built.
platforms.subtitle: Each one started as a job for a real operator, then became a product. You get the finished thing, not a discovery phase.

items.description: Walk-around checks, defect tracking and job cards for workshops and fleet operators. DVSA-shaped, signed on the device, audit-ready without a filing cabinet.
Boards, sprints, timesheets and a fully branded client portal in one place. Clients see progress and hours under your name — and AI agents can work the backlog directly over MCP.
Import the bank statement, categorise once, invoice from a product library, and file a cash-receipts VAT return. The parts of the accounting package people actually open, without the subscription.
Booking through to proof of delivery: jobs, drivers, routes and a customer portal that shows where the load is. Invoicing falls out of the completed job instead of a Friday spreadsheet.
